name: unicorn
lore:
Imagine stepping into a sun-dappled glade, where ancient trees whisper secrets to the wind. There, amidst the emerald foliage, stands a unicorn. Its coat is as white as freshly fallen snow, its mane and tail shimmering like spun moonlight. A single, spiraled horn, ivory in hue, rises from its forehead, pulsing with a gentle, ethereal light. This is no mere beast, but a creature of pure magic, a guardian of the forest, and a beacon of hope in a world shrouded in darkness.

Unicorns are more than just beautiful creatures; they are embodiments of nature's most potent magic. They are drawn to places of unspoiled wilderness, where the veil between worlds is thin. Legends say that a unicorn's horn can purify the foulest waters, heal the gravest wounds, and even ward off the most malevolent of spirits. They are fiercely protective of their homes and those who dwell within, often forming deep bonds with fey creatures like pixies and dryads. To earn the trust of a unicorn is to gain a powerful ally, but to betray that trust is to invite their righteous wrath.

But be warned, for not all unicorns are creatures of light. Twisted by dark magic, some become corrupted versions of their former selves, beings of shadow and malice. These dark reflections serve as a grim reminder that even the purest of creatures can be tainted, and that the fight against darkness is never truly over.
